summary: Read several words that contain only lowercase English letters. When two words use the same letters and the same count of each letter, and differ only by order, place them in one family. Split the full list into such families and write the words of each family together. Families may be written in any order, and words inside a family may be written in any order. Every word belongs to exactly one family.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count followed by that many strings.
